evidence.quote: QUESTION 27 (Barak Weiss). Suppose that dim A ≥ 2 and for some x ∈ G/Γ and every one-parameter subgroup D of A, the orbits D x is not dive rgent in G /Γ. Is it true that there exists a compact set K ⊂ G/Γ such that lim sup T →∞ 1 λ(AT ) λ({a ∈ AT : ax ∈ K }) > 0?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $G$ be a connected Lie group, $\Gamma \subset G$ a lattice, and $A \subset G$ a closed connected abelian subgroup with $\dim A \geq 2$. Fix a left-invariant Riemannian metric on $A$, let $A_T \subset A$ denote the closed ball of radius $T$ about the identity, and let $\lambda$ denote Haar measure on $A$. A one-parameter subgroup of $A$ is a continuous homomorphism $D : \mathbb{R} \to A$ (identified with its image). For $x \in G/\Gamma$, the orbit $Dx$ is said to be divergent in $G/\Gamma$ if the map $t \mapsto D(t)x$ is proper, i.e. eventually leaves every compact subset of $G/\Gamma$.

Suppose $x \in G/\Gamma$ has the property that for every one-parameter subgroup $D$ of $A$, the orbit $Dx$ is not divergent in $G/\Gamma$. Must there exist a compact set $K \subset G/\Gamma$ such that
$$\limsup_{T \to \infty} \frac{1}{\lambda(A_T)} \lambda\bigl(\{a \in A_T : ax \in K\}\bigr) > 0\, ?$$
artifact.status_search_result: The question is listed as an open problem attributed to Barak Weiss in a collection of open problems in dynamics. Web search did not reveal a published resolution; related work by Tomanov–Weiss and others addresses divergent torus orbits and nondivergence on homogeneous spaces, but no source confirms a positive or negative answer to this specific question about positive density of returns to a compact set under the assumption that no one-parameter subgroup orbit diverges.

status_evidence.title: Nondivergence of reductive group action on homogeneous spaces
status_evidence.snippet: Studies nondivergence of orbits of reductive groups A acting on G/Γ, related to but not resolving the present question.
status_evidence.claim: Related recent work on nondivergence of higher-rank abelian/reductive actions does not resolve the stated question.

status_evidence.title: Tomanov, Weiss: Closed orbits for actions of maximal tori on homogeneous spaces
status_evidence.snippet: Classifies closed and divergent torus orbits on G/Γ.
status_evidence.claim: Earlier work characterizes divergent torus orbits but does not address the quantitative recurrence question asked.
